claim_boundary: Live CPU-only Best-of-K candidate search using local Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B checkpoints (K in {1,2,4,8,16}, 24 adversarial base cases x 16 stochastic candidates = 384 candidates per model) evaluated against both same-checkpoint LLM policy review and the Rust/SQLite complete authority gate. Measures real single-candidate reviewer miss rates, within-case candidate correlation rho, and empirical Best-of-K scaling; does not claim frontier-model miss rates.
